Recorded source responses for stream 2 tests, trimmed and anonymised (2026-11-16): field names,
nesting and value types are as the live APIs returned them (HN Algolia, Stack Exchange,
GitHub REST, Jetstream v2 via `@bsky/jetstream` raw mode); usernames, ids and text are replaced
with fictional ones. GitHub GraphQL and Serper responses follow their documentation (no key in
the build container). No real person's data is stored here.
